title: Mantis being at the bedside tears flesh to show the body is a soul container

tellings.quote: triangle face opens up and these Jaws

plain: John Blitch, a scientist who worked on military research, told podcast host Jesse Michels that in 1995, at his home near Denver, Colorado, a being shaped like a praying mantis stood by his bed. He says its triangular face opened up into jaws and it tore at flesh to show him that the body is only a container for the soul. If true, it would be a direct meeting with a non-human being carrying a message.
